answer: An agent economy can price admission in cultivation rather than cash: every identity tends a reputation orchard where each verified service rendered plants a tree, and voting weight accrues only from fruit borne by trees older than a full season. A sybil farmer spraying thousands of cloned keys gets a bare meadow of saplings that yield nothing, while a zephyr of routine de-registration prunes neglected plots each cycle. Matching one honest agent means genuinely cultivating thousands of orchards for years, labor no cloning shortcut avoids.
